SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, O.SAMPLENUM, O.ORDERDESC, O.REMARK, O.SAMPLEID, O.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, O.SAMPLEBEGINTIME, O.SAMPLECOMPLETEDATE, O.SAMPLECOMPLETETIME, O.LABELNO, M.STATUS AS ORDERTASKSTATUS, M.MONITORTMPLID, M.ORDERCATEGORY, M.ANALYSISDATE, M.TESTNAME, M.METHODNAME, M.TESTMETHODBASIS, M.INDEXID, M.CUPNO, M.EQUIPTACQUNO, N.INDEXNAME, F.PLANSAMPLEDATE, F.FOLDERNO, F.MONITORPOINTID, F.MONITORPOINTNO, F.MONITORPOINTNAME, F.SAMPLEUSERNAME, P.TESTORGNAME, P.ENTRUSTORGNAME, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.BIZCATEGORYCODE, P.REGISTDATE, R.ANALYSISUSERNAME, R.CHECKUSERNAME, R.ANALYSISBEGINDATE, E.EQUIPTNAME, E.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTNO, B.USETYPE, B.NONSNRANGE, B.COEFFICIENT, B.THEORYCONTENT, B.JUDGEBASIS, B.CALQCRESULT, C.SETNAME FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER O ON O.ID = A.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK M ON M.ID = A.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_INDEX N ON N.ID = M.INDEXID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER F ON F.ID = A.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON P.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN R ON R.ID = A.RUNID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT E ON E.ID = R.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM B ON B.ID = A.ITEMID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_STANDARD_SET C ON C.ID = B.STANDSETID) T
AND T.REPORTRESULT IS NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O, T_EMC_SUBCONTRACT_RECORD S WHERE O.ID = S.ORDERTASKID AND O.ID = T.ORDERTASKID AND O.FOLDERID = #{targetFolderId} AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NOT NULL)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.ID = T.ORDERTASKID AND O.FOLDERID = #{targetFolderId} AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.DATASHARING = '1')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.ID = T.ORDERTASKID AND O.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NULL)
ORDER BY
T.ORDERNO, T.TESTNAME, T.ITEMORDERNO, T.REPEATNO

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, A.FOLDERID, A.RUNID, A.ORDERID, A.ORDERNO, A.ORDERTASKID, A.TESTID, A.ITEMID, A.ITEMNAME, A.ITEMALIASNAME, A.ITEMORDERNO, A.REPEATNO, A.RESULTCATEGORY, A.ANALYSISTYPE, A.UNITNAME, A.SCRIPTFLAG, A.ORIGINALRESULT, A.REPORTRESULT, A.SUBMITFLAG, A.QCNAME, A.QCCATEGORYCODE, B.STATUS, B.CUPNO, B.TESTNAME, B.ORDERCATEGORY, C.MONITORPOINTNAME, M.USETYPE, E.SAMPLEID, E.RELATEDQCORDERNO, B.WEIGHINGDATE, B.WEIGHTENDDATE, B.VOCBOTTLE, B.OILFILMNO, B.SAMPLEBOTTLENO, F.PROJNO FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B ON B.ID = A.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER C ON C.ID = A.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM M ON A.ITEMID = M.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER E ON E.ID = A.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT F ON C.PROJID = F.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ORDERNO,T.TESTNAME, T.ITEMORDERNO, T.REPEATNO

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT OT.*, S.SCRIPT1, S.SCRIPT2, S.VALIDATESCRIPT, S.SETNAME, ITS.SETNAME ITEMSETNAME FROM (SELECT OTR.*, CASE OTR.QCCATEGORYCODE WHEN 'N/A' THEN I.STANDSETID ELSE QC.QCGROUP END STANDSETID, I.STANDSETID ITEMSTANDSETID, I.LIMITREVISION, CASE OTR.SCRIPTFLAG WHEN '1' THEN I.SCRIPT ELSE NULL END TESTSCRIPT, I.CALQCRESULT, I.INTERCEPTREVISION, I.SLOPEREVISION, I.LIMITFLAG, I.NEGATIVETOZERO, I.SCIENTIFICNOTATION, I.RESULTCATEGORY AS ITEMRESULTCATEGORY, I.AVGCALCTYPE, I.NONSNRANGE, I.DETECTEDQUANTITY, OT.STOCKBATCHNO, OT.TESTNAME, OT.METHODNAME, OT.PARENTID AS TASKPARENTID, OT.MONITORTMPLID, TM.RECOVERYRATE FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT OTR INNER JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT ON OTR.ORDERTASKID = OT.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM I ON OTR.ITEMID = I.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_QC_CATEGORY QC ON OTR.QCCATEGORYID = QC.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD TM ON I.TESTMETHODID = TM.ID) OT LEFT JOIN T_EMC_STANDARD_SET S ON OT.STANDSETID = S.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_STANDARD_SET ITS ON OT.ITEMSTANDSETID = ITS.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ORDERID, T.TESTID, T.ITEMORDERNO

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, A.FOLDERID, A.RUNID, A.ORDERID, A.ORDERNO, A.ORDERTASKID, A.TESTID, A.ITEMID, A.ITEMNAME, A.ITEMALIASNAME, A.ITEMORDERNO, A.REPEATNO, A.UNITNAME, A.LOWLIMIT, A.HIGHLIMIT, A.SCRIPTFLAG, A.SUBMITFLAG, A.ORIGINALRESULT, A.REPORTRESULT, A.AVGRESULT, A.RESULTSTATUS, A.RESULTCATEGORY, A.QCCATEGORYID, A.QCNAME, A.QCCATEGORYCODE, A.REPORTDISPLAY, A.PROJID, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.BIZCATEGORYCODE, F.FOLDERNO, F.SAMPLEORGID, F.SAMPLEORGNAME, F.TERMINATION, O.SAMPLEBEGINDATE, O.ORDERCATEGORY, S.REPORTCONFIGLINEID AS SAMPLEREPORTCONFIGLINEID, S.SAMPLENO, OT.TESTNAME, OT.CUPNO, OT.ANALYSISORGID, OT.ANALYSISORGNAME, OT.ANALYSISTYPE, OT.METHODNAME, OT.TESTMETHODBASIS, OT.STATUS AS ORDERTASKSTATUS, OT.SCHEMENAME, OT.EQUIPTACQUNO, OC.ORDERCONTAINERNO, QC.USECATEGORY FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON P.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER F ON F.ID = A.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER O ON O.ID = A.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_SAMPLE S ON S.ID = O.SAMPLEID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT ON OT.ID = A.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_CONTAINER OC ON OT.ORDERCONTAINERID = OC.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_POINT MP ON MP.ID = F.MONITORPOINTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_QC_CATEGORY QC ON A.QCCATEGORYID = QC.ID WHERE (P.ID IS NULL OR P.STATUS != 'cancel') ) T
AND T.RETESTORIGINALORDERTASKRESULTID IS NULL
AND T.REPORTDISPLAY = '1' AND T.ANALYSISTYPE = 'sampling' AND T.QCNAME = 'N/A'
AND T.REPORTDISPLAY = '1' AND T.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND T.QCNAME = 'N/A' AND T.RETESTORIGINALORDERTASKRESULTID IS NULL AND T.ORDERTASKSTATUS = #{status} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.FOLDERID = T.FOLDERID AND OT.QCCATEGORYCODE = 'N/A' AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND OT.RETESTORIGINALORDERTASKID IS NULL AND OT.TESTID != 1220/* 五日生化需氧量排除在外，可以不限制其状态 */
AND (OT.STATUS != 'auditFirst' AND OT.STATUS != 'auditSecond' AND OT.STATUS != 'done')
AND (OT.STATUS != 'auditSecond' AND OT.STATUS != 'done')
)
AND T.REPORTDISPLAY = '1' AND T.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND T.RETESTORIGINALORDERTASKRESULTID IS NULL
AND T.QCCATEGORYID IN (${qcCategoryId})
AND (T.QCCATEGORYCODE = 'N/A' OR T.USECATEGORY = 'scene' OR T.USECATEGORY = 'orderAccept')
AND T.TERMINATION != '1' AND T.REPORTDISPLAY = '1' AND T.QCCATEGORYCODE = 'N/A' AND T.RETESTORIGINALORDERTASKRESULTID IS NULL AND ((T.ANALYSISTYPE = 'sampling' AND (T.ORDERTASKSTATUS = 'audit' OR T.ORDERTASKSTATUS = 'done')) OR T.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND (T.ORDERTASKSTATUS = 'auditFirst' OR T.ORDERTASKSTATUS = 'auditSecond' OR T.ORDERTASKSTATUS = 'done') )
AND T.REPORTDISPLAY = '1' AND T.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND T.RETESTORIGINALORDERTASKRESULTID IS NULL
AND T.SCHEMENAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{schemeName}, '%')
AND T.ANALYSISORGID = #{analysisOrgId}
AND T.QCCATEGORYID IN (${qcCategoryId})
AND (T.QCCATEGORYCODE = 'N/A' OR T.USECATEGORY = 'scene' OR T.USECATEGORY = 'orderAccept')
ORDER BY
T.ANALYSISORGID ASC, T.FOLDERNO ASC

SELECT R.*, OT.TESTNAME, O.ORDERNO AS LABELNUMBER FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT R LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON R.PROJID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT ON R.ORDERTASKID = OT.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER O ON R.ORDERID = O.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM I ON R.ITEMID = I.ID WHERE R.RUNID = #{runId} AND (R.PROJID IS NULL OR P.STATUS != 'cancel') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_TEST_METHOD_QC_ITEM I LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD_QC Q ON I.TESTMETHODQCID = Q.ID WHERE Q.TESTMETHODID = R.TESTMETHODID AND Q.QCCATEGORYCODE = R.QCCATEGORYCODE AND I.ITEMID = R.ITEMID )

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, A.FOLDERID, A.RUNID, A.ORDERID, A.ORDERNO, A.ORDERTASKID, A.TESTID, A.ITEMID, A.ITEMNAME, A.ITEMALIASNAME, A.ITEMORDERNO, A.REPEATNO, A.UNITNAME, A.SCRIPTFLAG, A.ORIGINALRESULT, A.REPORTRESULT, A.ANALYSISTYPE, A.SUBMITFLAG, A.QCNAME, A.QCCATEGORYCODE, B.CUPNO, B.TESTNAME, B.ORDERCATEGORY, C.MONITORPOINTNO, C.MONITORPOINTNAME, I.USETYPE, case when O.PARENTORDERNO is not null then O.PARENTORDERNO else O.SAMPLEPARAMORDERNO end as ORDERNUMBER, O.PARENTORDERNO, C.PARAMPROJID, O.FREQUENCY ,O.`CYCLE` ,O.SAMPLEPARAMORDERNO ,C.FOLDERNO FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B ON B.ID = A.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER O ON O.ID = A.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER C ON C.ID = A.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM I ON I.ID = A.ITEMID ) T
AND T.PARAMPROJID = #{paramProjId} and left(T.FOLDERNO, length(T.FOLDERNO)-5) in ( select F.FOLDERNO from t_emc_folder F left join T_EMC_ORDER O on F.ID = O.FOLDERID where F.PROJID = #{paramProjId} and O.SAMPLEID = #{sampleId})
ORDER BY
T.ORDERNUMBER asc, T.PARENTORDERNO asc

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, A.FOLDERID, A.RUNID, A.ORDERID, A.ORDERNO, A.ORDERTASKID, A.TESTID, A.ITEMID, A.ITEMNAME, A.ITEMALIASNAME, A.ITEMORDERNO, A.REPEATNO, A.UNITNAME, A.SCRIPTFLAG, A.ORIGINALRESULT, A.REPORTRESULT, A.ANALYSISTYPE, A.SUBMITFLAG, A.QCNAME, A.QCCATEGORYCODE, B.CUPNO, B.TESTNAME, B.ORDERCATEGORY, C.MONITORPOINTNO, C.MONITORPOINTNAME, I.USETYPE, case when O.PARENTORDERNO is not null then O.PARENTORDERNO else O.ORDERNO end as ORDERNUMBER, O.PARENTORDERNO, C.PARAMPROJID ,O.FREQUENCY ,O.`CYCLE` ,O.SAMPLEPARAMORDERNO ,C.FOLDERNO,I.SAMPLEPARAM FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK B ON B.ID = A.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER O ON O.ID = A.ORDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER C ON C.ID = A.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM I ON I.ID = A.ITEMID ) T
AND T.ORDERID IN (SELECT O.ID FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.SAMPLEID=#{sampleId} ) AND T.ANALYSISTYPE ='sampling' AND T.SAMPLEPARAM ='1'
ORDER BY
T.orderno asc, t.TESTID asc, T.PARENTORDERNO asc
